source.quote: In the context of the market-specific challenges we saw in H1 and continue to face, I now expect the full year organic net sales growth to be toward the lower end of our medium-term guidance of 4% to 6%.
We continue to expect broadly flat organic net sales growth and low to midsingle-digit organic operating profit growth.
We still expect free cash flow for around $2 billion after exceptional costs and excluding EABL.
